metadata.notes: From a save that beat Blaine and turned Bill down: he waits in the Cinnabar Pokemon Center (pret CinnabarIsland_EventScript_DeclineSailToOneIsland clears FLAG_HIDE_CINNABAR_POKECENTER_BILL). The gate is the Volcano Badge, not a badge count or the Hall of Fame: Blaine's win (pret data/maps/CinnabarIsland_Gym/scripts.inc, CinnabarIsland_Gym_EventScript_DefeatedBlaine) sets FLAG_BADGE07_GET and starts Bill's scene outside (VAR_MAP_SCENE_CINNABAR_ISLAND 1, data/maps/CinnabarIsland/scripts.inc), and on the way to One Island the Hall of Fame (FLAG_SYS_GAME_CLEAR) changes only which line Bill introduces the player with (data/maps/OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F/scripts.inc). The Vermilion ferry needs the Tri-Pass first (pret VermilionCity_EventScript_FerrySailor), so the first trip is Bill's. YES runs one script to the end: out of the Center with him, the Seagallop from Cinnabar's shore, the walk from One Island's harbor into its Center, and Celio's scene, which gives the Meteorite, the Tri-Pass and the Town Map's Sevii page (pret OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_EventScript_MeetCelioScene). It also sets FLAG_SYS_PC_STORAGE_DISABLED until Three Island's port. The Cinnabar Center has no map file: the walk goes through its coded room (Frlg_overworld.Standard_center), as the fork's story walks every Center in the shared layout.

checkpoint.title: Fly to Cinnabar; Bill takes the Seagallop to One Island, Celio gives the Tri-Pass

events.why: Out of the Dept. Store by the west door, to fly.
Bill waits in Cinnabar's Pokemon Center.

Into the Center and west of Bill (11, 5), facing him: a table fills the tile below him, and his script walks out with a player facing south, east or west (pret CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_EventScript_Bill).
"Ready to set sail to ONE ISLAND?" YES: out with Bill, the Seagallop, One Island.
Celio's scene: the Meteorite, the Tri-Pass and the Town Map's Sevii page; the player ends below Bill, facing him.
